desc: Derive and prove the reduction: f(L,R) = number of maximal runs of consecutive values in V(S) = |distinct values| − (# adjacent pairs {v,v+1} both present). Max-matching framing was wrong; corrected proof complete.

Implement adjacent-pair sum: sweep R, maintain lastR[w] and global S = Σ_v min(lastR[v], lastR[v+1]), adjust edges (x−1,x) and (x,x+1) in O(1) per step, accumulate S. Answer = distinct_sum − pair_sum.

Verify on samples: found distinct_sum bug — `(i − prev[i])·(nxt[i] − i)` counts unique-occurrence (not first-occurrence) subarrays; correct formula is `(i − prev[i])·(n − i + 1)` (verified: gives 18 for sample 1, answer 18−2=16 ✓). Pair-sum sweep verified correct.
Apply the verified fix to the code: distinct_sum contribution is `(i - prev[i]) * (n - i + 1)`, unused `nxt` computation removed; final O(N) solution matches the proven identity and sample 1 (16).
